company.name: Deepnote
company.shortDescription: Deepnote is a collaborative data science notebook for teams that is shareable, Jupyter-compatible, and runs in the cloud.
company.description: Deepnote is building the best data science notebook for teams. In the notebook, users can connect their data, explore, and analyze it with real-time collaboration and version control. Users can easily share project links with team collaborators, or with end-users to present polished assets. All of this is done through a powerful, browser-based UI that runs in the cloud. We built Deepnote because data scientists don't work alone.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based collaborative data science notebook compatible with Jupyter that supports Python, SQL, and R for data analysis and exploration.

productsAndServices.description: Features to schedule notebook executions and deploy notebooks as APIs for production use and model serving.

productsAndServices.description: Cloud-based collaboration tools including real-time editing, commenting, version control, and access management for data teams.

productsAndServices.description: Built-in integrations with numerous databases, data warehouses, file storage, and collaboration tools for seamless data access.
